Marissa / Karthik — quick internal follow-up from today’s 6/21 alignment (we met 10:00–10:20am ET):

Summary highlights for internal owners:
- Primary success steward: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai). She will own pilot monitoring, acceptance evidence collection, and the go-live checklist automation.
- Pilot owner (first 30 days): Tessa Morgan (operational lead) — I will execute the ramp plan and capture acceptance artifacts.
- Security/Infra lead: Karthik Iyer — own KMS policy review, secure FTP configuration, and any SOC-related evidence requests.

Action items assigned (owner — due):
- Marissa — build acceptance checklist template in Drive and populate with SOW criteria (due 2027-06-25). Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/u/0/folders/1GzHB-HB-ramp
- Karthik — send KMS grant policy example and required key policy change list to procurement & Samantha (due 2027-06-23).
- Tessa — schedule pilot kickoff runbook review and confirm environment provisioning slot for 7/01 (due 2027-06-24).
- Ben — confirm DocuSign envelope status and forward final signed SOW to security (done: HubSpot#HS-9482).

Risks & mitigations:
- If KMS approval delays beyond 6/24, we will run a masked-data ingestion test to validate pipelines without production keys.
- Procurement may request a minor SLAs appendix — we have a template; Karthik / Marissa, I’ll loop in legal if they press for changes.

I’ve attached the action tracker updated post-call. Marissa — I’ll hand off the pilot tracker to you on 6/25 and we’ll schedule the formal steward handoff on 7/02 (15–30 min).

Thanks — Tessa
